title: XDC epoch rewards per owner per UTC day
description: Totals of rewards credited to each owner address on one UTC day, all of the owner's masternodes combined. For accounting and tax records.

$schema.description: URL of the JSON Schema for this document.

epochs.description: Epochs paid on this day that are included.

reward_wei.description: Total for the day (unverified epochs left out). Exact integer wei as a decimal string (1 XDC = 10^18 wei).

epochs_paid.description: Epochs this owner was paid on this day (unverified epochs left out).

node_count.description: The most eligible masternodes the owner had in any epoch counted that day.

unverified.description: Epochs on this day whose figure for this owner was marked unverified (see the epoch-rewards schema). They are NOT included in reward_wei or epochs_paid: check them against your own records.

epoch.description: Epoch the figure was paid in.

measured_wei.description: The raw measured figure in wei; part of it may not be reward.

value_usd.description: Sum of each epoch's value at the price recorded then.

epochs_valued.description: How many of this owner's epochs value_usd covers.
